correctness.rationale: From actual pinned RESULT.md 2f33e5a4dd749cb4c22bcf63381e28b7d2c4799e, the backwards independent exponential clock gaps give stationary Gaussian variance V_s=(2Ds/lambda) sum_{j>=0}(1-s)^{2j} Z_j. Conditioning yields the exact scaled log-MGF -s sum log(1-t q_s^j) with t=(D/lambda)||theta||^2<1. Riemann convergence gives Li_2(t)/2; its steep boundary gradient makes tilts attain all z and yields exponential tightness and full LDP. Radial dual criticality gives c=y^2/(1-e^-y) and theta.z=y; strict decreasing Hprime=1/[2w(t)] gives multi-particle gap and orthant continuity. Limit N,k fixed, not uniform. Independently checked finite-s MGF convergence, H against numerical Legendre dual and c-boundary asymptotics; finite checks not an infinite proof.
